source: University of Iowa MIS yarn mallet AIFF
tuning: equal temperament A4=440 Hz; measured source modal ratios retained
decay_method: fit log amplitude per second, exp(-1/(output_rate*tau)), Q15
dynamics_method: mf modes; existing linear fundamental/quadratic brightness
body_filter: existing fixed 385/727 Hz coloration, included in calibration
apple_reference_calibration: KEY0 reference retained; no four-note attack offsets

bass_boost.curve: flat C2-B2; raised cosine B2-C4; zero at and above C4

loudness_calibration.method: 80 Hz highpass, +0.5 of 1500 Hz highpass, RMS of first 300 ms
loudness_calibration.unit: weighted PCM RMS proxy, not LUFS
loudness_calibration.scope: complete integer modal/noise/body/limiter chain; one gain per note

modes.disabled: stationary residual, not a short upper mode
